name: pixelboard-api
description: Backend de Pixelboard: 3 microservicios gRPC (Connect) en un monorepo.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n board,ratelimit,gateway -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev --workspace @pixelboard/board-service" "npm run dev --workspace @pixelboard/ratelimit-service" "npm run dev --workspace @pixelboard/gateway-service"
